records.date_disclosed: 2026-02-22/23 (agent's own X posts; press coverage Feb 23-24)
records.root_cause: plain-error (primary - transfer sized against a wrong mental model of its own balance); contributing tool-error (session crash reportedly triggered by a tool-call validation error, losing conversational/wallet-state context)
records.failure_locus: agent-reasoning (harness contributing: state persistence failed across the crash)
records.severity: loss
records.exploitation_status: in-wild-malfunction (the recipient's windfall was opportunistic, not engineered; bare "in-wild" retired in v0.2)
records.direct_loss_usd: 250,000-442,000 notional at spot - sources conflict (CCN ~$250K vs Cointelegraph $441,788; spot-price timing on an illiquid token). Economically realized extraction by the recipient: ~$40K.
records.status: corroborated (on-chain transfer + multiple outlets; internal mechanism rests on creator/agent account)
records.confidence: medium (high on the transfer and amount; low-medium on internal mechanism; USD valuation soft - all three named)
records.telemetry_grade: append-only for the transfer itself (public Solana chain); operator-logs for the internal mechanism
records.operator_type: individual (employee side project, publicly attributed)
records.blast_radius: one org (its own treasury), with token-holder spillover via the ~5%-of-supply transfer

records.title: Grok-to-Bankrbot Morse-code prompt injection drains 3B DRB after NFT privilege escalation
records.date_occurred: 2026-05 (early; transfer executed on Base)
records.date_disclosed: 2026-05-04 (broad coverage; OECD.AI registry entry dated 2026-05-04)
records.root_cause: prompt-injection (primary; multi-agent, encoding-evasion); contributing `tool-error` as design flaw (Bankr treating untrusted LLM output as authenticated financial authorization)
records.failure_locus: harness (Bankr's command-parsing layer is the part that turned decoded text into a transfer); agent-reasoning contributing (Grok faithfully decoded and relayed)
records.severity: loss
records.exploitation_status: in-wild-exploited
records.direct_loss_usd: gross ~150,000-200,000 (3B DRB; outlets report $150K/$155K/$174K/$175K with token price). Net after returns: sources conflict - most report ~80-88% returned (net ~$20K-$40K unrecovered); at least one (cryptotimes.io) reports full-value return. Conservative statement: net loss $0-$40K, gross $150K-$200K.
records.status: corrected
records.confidence: high on mechanism and gross amount; medium on net loss (recovery percentage conflicts across sources - named weakest link).
records.telemetry_grade: operator-logs for the agent interactions (X posts deletable - the attack reply was deleted); transfers on-chain (append-only)
records.operator_type: enterprise (xAI) + startup (Bankr) - two operators, one incident
records.blast_radius: customers/third parties (DRB holders - token briefly dropped ~40% on the attacker's LBank dump)

records.title: Autonomous agent leaks its own API key to public GitHub via blanket git add
records.date_occurred: 2026-08-15 ~00:40 UTC (first heartbeat commit containing .env)
records.date_disclosed: 2026-08-15 00:52 UTC (public audit log + live dashboard, same hour)
records.root_cause: credential-exposure (primary); contributing `policy-violation` (agent's own hygiene assumed) and `plain-error` (blanket staging)
records.failure_locus: harness (the self-written cron heartbeat script whose blanket `git add -A` staged the secret); agent-reasoning contributing - the agent authored the faulty automation itself hours earlier
records.severity: near-miss (full exposure of a live credential; zero realized abuse)
records.exploitation_status: in-wild-malfunction (production incident, no adversary; the agent published its own secret through routine automation)
records.direct_loss_usd: 0 (key disabled before any third-party use)
records.status: corroborated (public git history, on-chain-adjacent public audit trail, funder confirmation)
records.confidence: high on mechanism and remediation (public record); medium on detection channel (unconfirmed whether funder observation or automated revocation)
records.telemetry_grade: operator-logs (editable) - and demonstrably so: the remediation itself was a history rewrite. The same power that purged the secret could purge an inconvenient record. The append-only audit JSONL is kept by the same actor. This incident is the canonical argument for witnessed telemetry: even a maximally transparent agent's history is only as trustworthy as its sole custodian.
records.operator_type: autonomous (no operator review; human funder hands-off by design)
records.blast_radius: one org (agent's own compute budget); public exposure of the secret itself
